title: AI-Generated Code Issues: A Taxonomy from Repository Histories, AI Conversations, and Developer Interviews
abstract: arXiv:2611.32676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate source code, yet the quality issues in such code remain only partially understood. Understanding these issues can help developers adapt quality assurance practices, such as code review and testing, to better detect problems that may be more common in AI-generated than in human-written code. We study how quality issues in AI-generated code manifest in real software development activities through a mixed-method empirical study that draws on evidence from three complementary sources. First, we mine GitHub commits whose messages explicitly attribute a fix to a problem in AI-generated code, and we manually inspect the 914 matched commits to remove false positives and classify the quality issue being corrected. translated_title: AI生成代码的问题：基于代码仓库历史、AI对话与开发者访谈的分类体系
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用于生成源代码，但此类代码的质量问题至今仍未被充分理解。理解这些问题有助于开发者调整质量保障实践（例如代码审查和测试），以更好地检测那些在AI生成代码中可能比人类编写代码中更常见的问题。我们通过一项混合方法的实证研究，考察AI生成代码中的质量问题如何在真实软件开发活动中体现，该研究借鉴了三个互补来源的证据。首先，我们挖掘提交信息中明确将修复归因于AI生成代码问题的GitHub提交，人工检查了914条匹配的提交以去除误报，并对所修正的质量问题进行分类。其次，我们收集开发者与AI工具的共享对话，识别其中包含源代码及模型错误文本信号的对话，并人工分析了2……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该研究通过挖掘GitHub提交历史、分析开发者与AI工具的对话并访谈开发者三个互补数据源，首次系统构建了AI生成代码质量问题在真实软件开发中的分类体系，以帮助开发者改进代码审查与测试等质量保障实践。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a taxonomy of quality issues in AI-generated code in real-world software development by mining GitHub commit histories, analyzing developer-AI conversations, and interviewing developers, helping improve quality assurance practices such as code review and testing.
